title: Python desktop app (Tkinter) packaged as an executable
description: Native-looking desktop GUI using only the Python standard library (Tkinter/ttk): menu bar, sidebar list, editor pane, status bar, JSON persistence and unit-tested logic. Packages into a standalone .exe / .app with PyInstaller.
produces: Standalone desktop executable: .exe on Windows, .app on macOS, binary on Linux
run: cd __APP_NAME__ && python3 app.py   (no dependencies needed to run)
build: Build mode creates .venv, installs PyInstaller, runs the unit tests and packages the app into dist/
Windows .exe: run build_exe.bat on Windows, or push to GitHub and download the artifact from the 'Build executables' workflow
customize: store.py: the data model and persistence (pure Python, unit-tested in tests/)
app.py App._build_ui(): widgets and layout; menu in App._build_menu()
app.py event handlers (on_new, on_save, on_delete, ...) connect the UI to the store
